}}'''Alvera Ramosanya''' was an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Yellow Ajah]] who was raised to the [[Amyrlin Seat]] in {{Ne|549}}.

==History==
Alvera held the position for twenty-nine years till her death in {{Ne|578}}. She was [[Eldaya Tolen]]'s successor and [[Shein Chunla]]'s predecessor.{{ref/book|bwb|24}}

During her reign, the [[Aiel]] gave the [[Cairhienin]] a [[chora]] sapling in gratitude for the water their ancestors were given by those of the Cairhienin.{{ref/book|bwb|14}}

Though she tried to establish some measure of leadership, she was a weak Amyrlin. The [[Hall]] had been in control of the [[White Tower]] with her two predecessors and chose Alvera for that purpose. She died at a young age, she was 248. There is a possibility that she was actually murdered in an attempt to assert some authority.{{ref/book|twotc|Alvera Ramosanya}}
